title: Triage candidates (family-shaped)
description: Output of the triage agent: workload-entry families worth investigating in depth. Triage selects WHAT to investigate (representative txs / blocks / contract calls); analyzer determines WHERE the actual optimization handle lives. Span identity is intentionally not committed at this layer.

noise_floor_pct.description: Per-host noise floor computed from baseline vs baseline-rerun timing, or the precomputed fallback for single-run imports.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier; used as a path segment by downstream phases (analyses/<id>/...).

kind.description: Family kind. Single source of truth for the family's shape; representative_ids is constrained by this value via the candidate-level allOf below.

selection_lens.description: The value-axis lens that triage promoted this family on. `tx_latency` = wall-time savings under execution-bucket spans; `tenure_throughput` = Clarity-budget headroom freed (the deterministic Clarity cost units, NOT time); `commit_time` = wall-time savings under commit-bucket spans. Triage allocates candidate slots across the three lenses according to operator weights (see STACKS_BENCH_AXIS_WEIGHTS). The analyzer must dispose of this lens explicitly via lens_disposition on its analysis output.

representative_ids.description: 1–3 representative workload entry points the analyzer should inspect. Shape is constrained by the top-level `kind` field (see allOf below).

rationale.description: One-liner explaining why this family is worth investigating. Detail belongs in supporting evidence, not here.

bucket.description: Optional, non-binding hint: which work bucket triage believes the family's optimization handle lives under (see prompts/bucket-anchors.md). The analyzer commits the authoritative bucket on each emitted target; this field exists so reviewers and the analyzer can see triage's read.

suspected_spans.description: Optional, non-binding hints: spans triage suspected may be the cost center within this family. The analyzer is free to confirm, refine, or replace these with a different target_span based on its own trace + code investigation.

global_materiality.description: Aggregate signal the analyzer should use when judging whether a target found within this family generalizes beyond the family.

pct_blocks.description: Maximum pct_blocks across suspected_spans (or family span set) from span_recurrence.

self_wall_ms.description: Sum of self_wall_ms across suspected_spans (or family span set) from span_recurrence.

stacks_tx_ids.description: Heaviest representative transactions exercising this contract.function.
